statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The denial reason code was CO-197
The denial was because required authorization was missing
The clinical indication note documents recurrent unexplained syncope and near-syncope
The clinical indication note raises concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of known sick sinus syndrome
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings during daily activities
